figures.finding: Liberia's Ministry of Information, Cultural Affairs and Tourism (MICAT) regulates film through its Motion Picture Review Division, set up by an act of 1976: every locally produced or imported film must be previewed and approved before public screening or broadcast, and cinemas and mobile cinema units need a MICAT permit.

value.law: act of the Legislature, May 1976; PRC Decree 46
value.approval: all local and imported films before screening or TV broadcast
value.permits: cinemas, mobile units, video clubs, TV stations
